summary.intent: Plan and execute Phase 58 (ipns-signature-verify-coverage) using the GSD workflow system — generating PLAN.md files via research, pattern mapping, planning, and verification, then executing plans via wave-based subagent dispatch.
summary.outcome: Planning completed successfully: 4 plans in 2 waves, all gates passed (0 blockers, 1 cosmetic warning fixed inline), HARD-09 covered, decisions D-01..D-13 addressed. Execution began but plan 58-01 executor crashed mid-task-3 due to an API socket drop, leaving Task 3 uncommitted and Task 4 unstarted; a continuation executor was spawned.

repo: crates/crypto cannot dev-depend on api-client/core, so cross-language verify vectors (58-04) live in crates/fuse/tests/ rather than crates/crypto/tests/
CBOR cid/sequence binding uses the ciborium crate; it was added to both crates/core (decode helper) and crates/fuse (verify.rs wrapper) in separate commits
9 FUSE resolve sites (events, fs, metadata, publish, replay) needed routing through the new resolve_ipns_verified chokepoint
Local stack (redis:6380, api:3000, postgres, ipfs/kubo) was confirmed up before execution, which is required for 58-02's full-SDK-E2E gate at decision D-10
Phase 58 uses TDD mode with fine granularity; VALIDATION.md frontmatter must be written before the planner spawns when Nyquist validation architecture is enabled
ROADMAP wave dependency annotations were already present (idempotent write); STATE.md is the correct place to record planning completion

code.finding: ciborium was added as a dependency here by the 58-01 executor; a stale diagnostic falsely reported it missing after the socket drop
New file — resolve_ipns_verified wrapper created in Task 2 of 58-01; committed before the crash
Open Questions section lacked (RESOLVED) markers; plan checker flagged as cosmetic warning; fixed with inline resolution markers rather than re-spawning the planner

workflow: GSD commit helper emits commit_failed as a known false negative; always verify with git log rather than retrying

Sequential execution on the feature branch was chosen over parallel-worktree mode for this security phase — project memory warns that parallel worktrees cause cwd-drift, merge failures, and stranded worktrees
A single cosmetic plan-checker warning can be fixed directly (doc edit + commit) instead of burning a full planner revision cycle
When an executor crashes mid-task, check uncommitted diff and git log before spawning a continuation — the diff may be larger than the error message implies
AUTO_MODE (--auto flag) means checkpoint gates self-approve; the human checkpoint at 58-02's D-10 E2E gate still requires human approval regardless

friction: API socket connection closed mid-execution of 58-01 executor, dropping the completion signal and leaving Task 3 (+265/-83 lines across 5 files) uncommitted and Task 4 (sdk-core JS binding) not started
Stale diagnostic after socket drop falsely reported ciborium missing from crates/fuse/Cargo.toml — the dep had already been added in a prior commit
GSD commit helper false-negative (commit_failed) required a manual git log verification step every time a commit was made

58-01 Task 4 (sdk-core symmetric CBOR cid/sequence JS binding): not started
